scenicChapters.title: Jangneung Cluster → Changdeokgung Palace Complex
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-cova-remigia-abric-l-cova-de-garg.story: A 106 km round trip from Ares del Maestre - roughly 1 h 50 in the saddle. The stops in between: Covatina del Tossalet del mas de !a Rambla, Cova de Gargán and back through Covatina del Tossalet del mas de !a Rambla. The highest point is about 1,300 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
